channel.title: Madagascar - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Madagascar, every source cited.

item.title: Madagascar seeks Russian investment in energy and agriculture
item.description: President Randrianirina wants Russian firms to process raw materials locally, creating jobs and industrial activity.

item.title: Madagascar pledges to centre women in ocean conservation
item.description: The island nation joins Belize in a global initiative to integrate female leadership into marine strategies and blue economies.

item.title: Madagascar braces for heavy rains and cooler temperatures
item.description: The national weather service issued a red alert for rainfall in specific regions starting October 30, 2026.

item.title: Madagascar and Turkey seek more economic cooperation
item.description: Ankara is interested in increased collaboration in energy, education, and trade, with agriculture and mining also targeted.
